## MapboxMapProps.keyboardNavigationEnabled property

Whether the map canvas is included in sequential keyboard navigation. Defaults to true to preserve Mapbox's keyboard controls.

**Signature:**

```typescript
keyboardNavigationEnabled?: boolean;
```
